acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
inferred: Data acquisition was performed using a data-dependent top-20 method, in full scan positive mode, scanning 350 to 1200 m/z.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 minutes at 60ºC.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and 10 mM chloroacetamide for 30 minutes at 60ºC.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Finally, samples were digested at 37°C with Pierce MS-grade trypsin (Thermo-Fisher Scientific) at an enzyme:substrate ratio of 1:20 (w/w) in 20 μL of a 100 mM TEAB solution.

collision_energy.evidence: Isolation of precursors was performed with a window of 1 m/z, exclusion duration (s) of 45 and the HCD collision energy was 32.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The top 20 most intense ions from each MS1 scan were selected and fragmented via Higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD).

ionization_type.evidence: A 500 ng aliquot of each digested sample was subjected to 1D-nano LC ESI-MS/MS (Liquid Chromatography Electrospray Ionization Tandem Mass Spectrometric) analysis

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: A 500 ng aliquot of each digested sample was subjected to 1D-nano LC ESI-MS/MS (Liquid Chromatography Electrospray Ionization Tandem Mass Spectrometric) analysis using an Ultimate 3000 nano HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled online to a Orbitrap Exploris 240 equipped with FAIMS Pro ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ptm.evidence: All searches were configured with dynamic modifications for pyrrolidone from Q (-17.027 Da) and oxidation of methionine residues (+15.9949 Da) and static modification as carbamidomethyl (+57.021 Da) on cysteine, monoisotopic masses, and trypsin cleavage (max 2 missed cleavages).
